name: runlit
description: A local-first desktop observer for AI tasks, versions, and artifacts.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n daemon,desktop -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @runlit/daemon" "npm run dev -w @runlit/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @runlit/protocol && npm run build -w @runlit/daemon && npm run build -w @runlit/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @runlit/protocol && npm run test -w @runlit/daemon && npm run test -w @runlit/desktop
